items.label: Seamless Underwear for Women
items.value: These women's seamless panties boast a laser-cut and tagless design. There were no tags or lines to bother your skin. Such a pair of no-show underwear will be an ideal companion to your leggings and bodycon dresses

items.label: High Waisted Elegance
items.value: The high-waisted design provides an excellent fit for your tummy. The double-layer design around the waist eliminates the issue of curling and rolling down. Elastic band that is flexible and stretches, while retaining shape

items.label: Scalloped Edging Design
items.value: These women's seamless panties are cute, soft, and sexy at the same time. The front has a scallop design, adding a feminine touch to the design

items.label: Perfect for Everyday Wear
items.value: From casual to formal wear, this pack of underwear is perfect for any outfit or occasion. The no-show design ensures they stay hidden, offering a clean, streamlined look. They flatter you

items.label: Long-Lasting & Washing Care
items.value: These panties are designed to be machine washable, easy to clean, and capable of retaining their shape and comfort even after multiple laundry cycles. For both comfort and hygiene, it is recommended that you replace your underwear every 3 months
